title: Ear sensation logged on blog before the Indian Ocean earthquake

tellings.quote: So that was in September of 03, I believe it was.

plain: A former sergeant named Dan Sherman, who says the NSA once hired him to talk with aliens, says he felt a strange sensation in his ear and recorded it on his blog before the great Indian Ocean earthquake, in "September of 03, I believe it was." He tells Michels this as his own experience and points to his blog and to a 2006 update of his book Above Black. If true, his sensations would have warned of the disaster before it struck.
